SPECIFICATION FOR KNIFE, CLASP
(Incorporating Amendment Nos. 1, 2 & 3) 1. Scope -- Covers requirements of clasp knife. 2. Materials Sl No. Component Material i) Carbon steel, Designation T90 of IS : 3749-1966 Blade 'Specification for tool and die steels for cold work' ii) Screw driver, tin opener and Carbon steel, Designation T65 of IS : 3749-1966 marline spike iii) Inner scale Mild steel, galvanized iv) Outer scale Chequered horn or unbreakable plastics v) Carbon steel, Designation C80 of IS : 2507-1965 Spring 'Specification for cold rolled steel strip for springs' vi) Bolster Mild steel vii) Shackle Copper wire viii) Rivets Mild steel 3. DETAILS OF COMPONENTS OF CLASP KNIFE

IS : 6291 - 1971
4. Workmanship and Finish 4.1 The blade, tin opener, marline spike and screw driver shall be properly forged, free from cracks, pits and other surface defects. They shall be hardened and tempered to hardnesses given in 5 and ground ready for use and shall be securely fitted in their respective positions, without any undue play or stiffness. Blade and tin opener shall close centrally and shall be capable of being opened by the normal force of hand. 4.2 All the metal components of the knife shall be finished smooth and bright. The outer scale shall be free from cracks and splits. The bolster shall be properly fitted. The cam of the blade, tin opener and marline spike shall be of correct shape with edges properly rounded to avoid difficult opening. The marline spike, when shut, shall fit close to the spring to avoid catching in the pocket. 5. Heat Treatment -- The various components of the knife shall be uniformly hardened and tempered to hardnesses as shown below against each: Blade 600 to 700 HV Screw driver, tin opener and 450 to 550 HV marline spike Spring 450 to 500 HV 5.1 Hardness shall be tested in accordance with IS : 1501-1968 'Method for Vickers hardness test for steel ( first revision )'. 6. Tests 6.1 The knife shall show no sign of damage on completion of the tests described in 6.1.1 to 6.1.4. 6.1.1 Blade, tin opener and marline spike shall be struck fiat 6 times on an aluminium block from a height of 300 mm for testing the flaws. 6.1.2 The cutting edges shall be vigorously struck 6 times against a soft aluminium block from a height of 300 mm at 4 or 5 points along its complete length. 6.1.3 The point of marline spike shall be struck 6 times against an aluminium or hardwood block from a height of 300 mm. 6.1.4 The screw-driver shall be tested for torque test as given in 8.1 of IS : 844 (Part 1)-1972 'Specification for screw-drivers: Part I Technical supply conditions (first revision )'. The testing torque shall be 100.0 N.m (10.00 kgf.m approximately). 6.2 Tests for Plastics Handles -- The knife fitted with outer scales made of unbreakable plastics shall be subjected to tests as given in 6.2.1 and 6.2.2. 6.2.1 Boiling -- The knife-shall be immersed completely for one hour in a boiling 5 percent soap solution, then rinsed immediately in water at 15 to 20�C and immediately re-immersed completely in boiling water for one hour. The knife shall then be rinsed again in water at 15 to 20�C. This procedure shall be repeated four times. During or on completion of the test, the outer scales shall show no sign of cracking, chipping or discolouring of the plastics. The rivets shall neither become loose nor shall there be any other damage 6.2.2 Impact -- This test shall be conducted after the boiling test. The knife in closed position shall be held vertically with the shackle end upward and dropped from a height of 1.2 m on to a concrete floor of on a flat stone five times in succession. The height shall be measured from the lowest point of the knife. To avoid the components coming out of the scales, the knife shall be tied with a string as near to the shackle as possible before dropping. During or on completion of the test, the outer scales shall not show any sign of cracking, breaking or chipping of the plastics and the rivets shall neither become loose nor shall there be any other damage after the test. 7. Marking -- Each knife shall be legibly and indelibly marked on the blade with the manufacturer's name, initials or recognized trade-mark. 7.1 ISI Certification Marking � Details available with the Indian Standards Institution 8. Packing -- Knife shall be packed as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier.
